inventory_principle: Replaces R22 Section 3.4's universal predicate-isolation claim with a body-grounded accounting of (1) the exact 61 retained unit test methods across 4 baseline modules (19-01.txt), distinguishing positive-only checks from negative/refusal checks, (2) the exact 8 new method definitions in test_receipt_routing.py (71f8a9ef3ca88e56b1ca283b34bdebbcd0770509cfa4938dcd0298b0027ffe05), whose executable guard coverage is UNESTABLISHED (and validate(c)/consent(c) routing predicates source-audit-only) until a separately authorized source alignment resolves the helper/exception/regex mismatches in test_receipt_routing.py and the HOST_SURFACES filesystem tripwires in routing_unit_driver.py (822a8f761eb1188f601d9d68e21fbda7942ccd870b5a162c77eb88d4632ac844), and (3) the guard/host functions verified by direct non-author source audit. Source inspection is never classified as unit test execution.

driver_execution_order.step_1_stdlib_and_mock_imports: Imports stdlib modules including unittest and unittest.mock before any tripwires are installed.

step_2_host_surfaces_tripwired_before_gu.r33_candidate_driver_822a8f76_note: routing_unit_driver.py (07-01.txt) replaced 13 of 15-01.txt's process/network/timer/rlimit tripwires with filesystem-mutation tripwires (os:chmod, os:fchmod, os:mkdir, os:makedirs, os:rmdir, os:unlink, os:remove, os:rename, os:replace, shutil:rmtree, shutil:copy2), which would tripwire tempfile.TemporaryDirectory and freeze_source in test_bounded_sdk_compile_link_fragment.py and test_r5_walk_treehash_freeze.py; execution is UNESTABLISHED until aligned with 15-01.txt.

driver_execution_order.step_3_guard_module_load: guard = load('bounded_sdk_compile', ...) executes top-level module definitions with HOST_SURFACES tripwired and 0 GUARD_SURFACES tripwired during module load.

step_4_guard_surfaces_tripwired_after_gu.difference: routing_unit_driver.py leaves guard.consent un-tripwired so test_receipt_routing.py directly calls guard.consent(c) against synthetic in-memory fixtures while keeping guard.check_pin and the other 26 runtime/cgroup/filesystem surfaces tripwired.

driver_execution_order.step_5_test_modules_loaded_and_executed: Loads the 5 pinned test modules (61 retained methods + 8 new routing methods = 69 total unit test methods) and runs them under unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).
